questions.stem: The locus of points that are exactly $3\text{ cm}$ from a straight line is:

options.text: A single line parallel to it, $3\text{ cm}$ away
Two parallel lines, one on each side, each $3\text{ cm}$ from the original line

questions.explanation: Points exactly $3\text{ cm}$ from a straight line lie on two parallel lines, one on each side of the original line, each at a perpendicular distance of $3\text{ cm}$.
